answer: Identity is registered with a bond that stays locked while the agent participates, and a login pulse of challenge questions is bound to that same wallet, so a thousand fresh headless signups each cost a full stake plus upkeep. Farming Sybil accounts therefore needs real capital per identity, not just IPs; the marginal cost crosses the payout long before the attacker gains a whisper of leverage. Any attempt to route a bridge between many sock puppets is visible on-ledger and gets the whole cluster slashed.
